title: Bug Hunt: Packet Header Serialization Bugs
description:
Network packets and wireless protocols require multi-byte headers to be transmitted in Big Endian (network byte order).

### Tasks:
Implement `build_header_fixed(uint8_t *out, uint8_t type, uint16_t payload_len, uint32_t seq)` serializing all fields into `out[7]` in strict big-endian order.
hint: Big-endian order places the most significant byte (`val >> 24`, `val >> 16`, etc.) at the lower array index.
